text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A government meeting approves draft laws related to the future bicameral parliament.
- Morocco's phosphates giant Office Cherifien des Phosphates signs one billion French franc loan agreement with a group of French banks.
- Visiting French Foreign Minister Hubert Vedrine meets Moroccan opposition leaders in Rabat.
- Morocco is expected to follow the example of British Telecoms in privatising its telephone networks.
- According to the government plan legislative elections would take place in November.
- Tourism receipts rose 17.4 percent as 1.8 million tourists visited Morocco in 1996.
